stages.title: 9:59 AM — normal morning
stages.detail: 750 req/s per side. Both balancers look identical.

stages.title: 10:00 AM — Tatkal booking opens
stages.detail: Traffic jumps to 2250 req/s per side: 75% of fleet capacity.

stages.title: backend-2 slows down
stages.detail: It still passes health checks but every request takes +400ms: a gray failure.

stages.title: backend-3 crashes
stages.detail: The process dies. It comes back by itself after 15 seconds.

stages.title: Final whistle
stages.detail: Traffic stops; the scoreboard is frozen.
